data.gender_notes: Marinus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Of or relating to the sea
data.long_meaning: Marinus is derived from the Latin word ‘maris’, meaning ‘sea’. In the Christian tradition, the name Marinus is associated with sailors and fishermen. It is also given as a nod to Saint Marinus, the patron saint of the Adriatic Sea. The name Marinus carries the meaning “Of or relating to the sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Marinus usually hope their child will grow to embody of or relating to the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם מרינוס מקורו בלטינית, ומשמעותו 'ים' או 'מר'. הוא קשור למילה הלטינית 'mare', שפירושה 'ים'. השם מרינוס משמש ככינוי לנוצרים שונים, ביניהם קדושים ומר martyrs. השם מרינוס מופיע גם בכתבי הברית הישנה והחדשה, אך אינו שם נפוץ.

in_greek.name: Μαρίνος
in_greek.meaning: όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό, σημαίνει 'θάλασσα'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαρίνος προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'marinus', που σημαίνει 'θάλασσα' ή 'από τη θάλασσα'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Μαρίνος συνδέεται με την έννοια της θάλασσας και της πνευματικής αναζήτησης. Ο Μαρίνος ήταν ένας κοινός όνομα μεταξύ των πρώτων Χριστιανών, ιδιαίτερα εκείνων που ζούσαν κοντά στη θάλασσα ή είχαν σχέση με τη ναυτική δραστηριότητα.

The Romans named their children Marinus as a tribute to their seafaring skills and, later, this name became associated with sailors and fishermen in Christian tradition. Marinus is also a common name in Mediterranean countries like Italy, Greece, and Malta.

It evokes images of the patron saint Marinus, the protector of sailors and fishermen, who is believed to have founded the ancient city of Marino on the Adriatic coast. The name carries a sense of spiritual connection to the maritime world and the divine powers that govern the seas and offer protection to those who navigate them. Marinus is a name that inspires courage, perseverance, and faith in the face of nature's challenges at sea.
